scripts.setup: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm --prefix engine ci
scripts.update-engine: git submodule update --remote engine && npm --prefix engine ci
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run link-check && npm run build && npm run screens
scripts.import-plan: python engine/scripts/extract_plan.py reference/plan.pdf --out reference/building.json --config plan.json --debug && node engine/scripts/import-building.mjs reference/building.json
scripts.fix-house: python engine/scripts/house_fixes.py reference/building.json && node engine/scripts/import-building.mjs reference/building.json
